changes.title: Music space
items: More space in the music: fewer parts playing at once in the grooves, a bigger reverb with crisp hits, and echoes that bounce left and right
The xylophone now plays chords and arpeggios in many genres, with a darker, lower one in the gentle start
The singer sings three-part harmonies under the grooves
Claps and finger snaps on the backbeat instead of a snare drum in most genres
Drums and bass sit bigger in the mix, and the whole thing is wider
The xylophone and finger snaps are now loud enough to hear
Basslines sit lower and deeper
Finger snaps and claps now take turns: snaps in the lighter stretches, claps when the music is full
The singer sings higher and brighter, the kick drum is deeper, and the xylophone and chords sit lower
The music leans more minor, with a darker turn at the end of each chord loop
Much less shaker
The singer now lands exactly with the lead melody instead of a touch late
New melodies: long held notes joined by quick runs and turns, over a rolling xylophone pattern
House sections get a bouncy two-bar riff played by the lead, xylophone and singer together, which builds each time it comes round
Breakdowns are dreamier and quieter, with stacked voices; breakbeat sections and drum & bass drops hit harder, with a gritty bass
The singer harmonises the hook when it lands
Some house riffs are now a simple chant on a three-three-two rhythm, with the singer on every note
The singer now leads: she sings the main tune herself in most styles, with the synth supporting underneath
Her voice is lighter and brighter, with a wide, dreamy echo around the long notes
The kick drum hits harder

changes.title: Banger mode
items: A new music mode, on by default: every night has one catchy hook that returns at the big moments (each wave landing, the drum & bass drop after a breakdown, the victory), with each wave's own riff in between
The night starts gentle and opens up into the full rave once the second stump has its soundsystem
Each genre has its own drum kit and groove, with fills, crashes and swing; builds strip the bass and kick away and leave a beat of silence before the drop
The singer sings the hook slowly in the breakdowns, and a sleeping legend's clearing hums it
A brighter, punchier mix, with a clean sub under the bass
The old music is one switch away with ?banger=0
Compressors on the drums and on the whole mix, for punch and to glue it together
A kick drum with more thump, and the bass ducking out of its way
Square-wave leads as the main sound, with a little pulse-wave reply; a few genres keep their own instruments
The singer doubles the hook when it lands, holds soft oohs under the grooves and adds sung stabs
The lead melodies sit lower and quieter, in the groove with the drums
A xylophone and finger snaps drift in and out for a spookier feel

changes.title: Melody rules
items: The melodies dance: the lead plays a catchy riff that repeats every bar and answers itself every fourth, in the styles of trance, hip-hop, witch house and bright electro-pop

Twelve new lead sounds to play them on: trance supersaws, plucks and stabs, a dusty electric piano, lo-fi keys and a breathy flute, a dark saw, a music box and a low choir, bright arpeggio synths, glassy bells and an airy synth voice
The singer sometimes sings a short, high hook over and over, and in the haunted breakdowns she sings the tune slowly before the drop plays it as a riff
The basslines step into each chord change, change over four bars, lock in with the kick drum and slide between notes in the hip-hop and witch-house styles
The house bass sits lower and rounder, moves smoothly from chord to chord, leaves the kick drum room, and changes its rhythm every few bars instead of bouncing on every offbeat

changes.title: Creature spell glow
items: Creatures' spells glow: a bright core with a pixel halo, a pool of light on the ground under each shot, hit and zone, and the brightest few light the forest around them
Legends' blows and party animals' spells glow too, in their own colours; Reduce flashing halves the glow
